refnamediv.refpurpose: Resolve filename against the include path

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
stringfalsestream_resolve_include_path stringfilename
Resolve filename against the include path according to the same rules as fopen/include.
Names starting with ./ or ../, absolute names and file:// URLs are not searched in the include path. When nothing matches, the directory of the executing script is tried, so the result depends on the calling file. Other URL schemes give &false;, and an unregistered scheme also emits an E_WARNING.
The function also returns &false; for a name that fopen with use_include_path, file_get_contents with use_include_path and include still open from the current working directory.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a string containing the resolved absolute path of an existing file or directory, &return.falseforfailure;. An empty name or . gives the first entry of the include path.
